prompt: Create a professional PowerPoint presentation about Claude AI with Anthropic brand styling. Apply Anthropic's official brand colors (dark #141413, light #faf9f5, orange #d97757, blue #6a9bcc, green #788c5d) and typography (Poppins for headings, Lora for body text). Save the final presentation as 'claude_presentation.pptx'.
